Job Title: Transmission Line Design Engineer or Engineer-in-Training 
 Job Level: ENG B/C/D ( We welcome applications from individuals with all levels of experience and will adjust the title and role accordingly) 
 Date Posted: July 13, 2026
 Closing Date: open until the position is filled
 Job Type: Full-time Permanent
 Category: Internal/External Opportunities 
 Location: Calgary
 Powering a bright future starts with you! 
 Oh, and, what do we do? 
 We power Alberta! Our transmission lines deliver electricity to millions of Albertans 24 hours a day, seven days a week. When you’re on our team, you’re supporting Alberta’s homes, farms, businesses and industries by providing the safe, reliable and affordable electricity they rely on. Whether working in the field or in the office, every AltaLinker contributes to keeping the lights on. Want to join our team? We’re excited to share that we are hiring a Transmission Line Design Engineer.   
 Job Description: 
 An exciting opportunity currently exists for a “Transmission Line Design Engineer” within the Project Development – Lines & Civil Engineering Department at AltaLink. Reporting to the Manager, Lines & Civil Engineering.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, engineering, project development and technical delivery of high voltage transmission line facilities across AltaLink’s transmission line network, from early scoping and conceptual development through detailed design, construction support, close-out and final acceptance. The individual will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure line modifications, line rebuilds, customer interconnections, greenfield transmission line projects and urgent restoration work are designed and supported with a high level of quality, safety, constructability and customer service. 
 The position requires experience in project scoping, design, implementation, technical decision-making, construction support and final acceptance. The role also requires the ability to coordinate multi-stakeholder design inputs, manage design changes, support external EPC and contractor resources, and provide clear technical direction under tight project or field response timelines. As a senior designer on the team, the individual will provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and designers. This includes supporting technical development, coaching, design review, and knowledge transfer for emerging engineers and EITs. This position will appeal to individuals looking to apply extensive transmission line design experience and leadership talents in a dynamic utility environment.
 Responsibilities: 
 Prepare detailed calculations, studies, bills of material and design packages for transmission line capital, customer, Direct Assign and system projects.
 Prepare PLS-CADD models for design package development and existing line clearance evaluations.
 Complete line design packages for all AltaLink transmission voltage classes, including 69kV, 138kV, 240kV and 500kV assets, including rebuilds, modifications, greenfield lines, customer interconnections and emergency restoration work.
 Lead preliminary line design, route and structure option development, constructability review, material selection and design change resolution for complex transmission projects.
 Apply base geotechnical knowledge when developing line designs, including understanding soil classifications, borehole/geotechnical investigation outputs, groundwater/bedrock considerations, soil strength/deformation behaviour, frost depth, corrosivity data and backfill requirements as they relate to transmission line foundation selection and constructability.
 Support transmission line foundation design decisions for direct-embed poles, drilled shafts/caissons, screw/helical/bucket piles, driven piles, micro-piles, grillage and pad/footing applications, including review of compression, uplift, shear and moment reactions.
 Coordinate with geotechnical consultants, civil/foundation designers, project managers, construction resources and pile/foundation contractors to define geotechnical scope, review investigation results and resolve foundation design or installation risks.
 Consider foundation risk mitigation during design and construction support, including cave-in/sloughing risk, high groundwater, shallow bedrock, gravel/boulder interference, casing/culvert needs, washed gravel/backfill selection and impacts to schedule, cost, safety and reliability.
 Provide timely and effective technical input to support the Project Development and Execution teams.
 Develop scope descriptions for project estimating and provide clear implementation direction to internal designers, external engineering consultants, EPC contractors, construction resources and field crews.
 Review and/or approve technical drawings and specifications submitted by internal designers or contractors to ensure each project meets acceptable standards for operability, functionality, maintainability, reliability, durability and safety.
 Support construction execution and project close-out by resolving field questions, material issues, redline updates, design clarifications and as-built/return-data requirements.
 Support engineering standards development, design practice improvements and application of current or historical code requirements, including AEUC, CSA and applicable ISO reliability requirements.
 Provide subject matter support for line optimization, line rating, thermal rating, reconductoring assessments, facility applications, information requests and regulatory/hearing support as required.
 Contribute to material governance, supplier engagement, technical specifications, procurement support and emergency spare/material strategy for transmission line assets.
 Build and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers, external technical engineering resources, construction resources, customers and other stakeholders that results in growing understanding, good decisions and effective cooperation.
 Report on project engineering status to Project Managers and the Engineering Manager.
 Mentor junior engineers, EITs and designers through technical coaching, design reviews, knowledge sharing and support toward professional development.
 Provide leadership support within the team as required, including coordination of team deliverables, technical prioritization and coverage for management or project leadership needs.
 Maintain competency with current industry standards and regulatory groups such as AEUC, CSA and ISO Rules.
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil or Electrical Engineering.
 EIT or Professional Engineer with the Association of Engineers and Geoscientists of Alberta (APEGA) or qualifies for registration with APEGA.
 Transmission Line Design experience is considered an asset. 
 Proven ability to perform the responsibilities listed above. 
 Demonstrated experience delivering complex transmission line designs from concept through close-out, including coordination with project managers, external designers, contractors, suppliers and field stakeholders.
 Knowledge of standards and codes that apply to transmission line design and the ability to research and apply past code requirements to existing facilities in current situations, including Alberta power system facilities, Alberta Utility Code (AUC/AEUC) and Canadian Standards Association (CSA) requirements.
 Working knowledge of transmission line materials, structure families, insulator and hardware selection, conductor/OPGW applications, foundations, steel poles, wood poles and constructability considerations.
 Base knowledge of geotechnical investigation programs and geotechnical data used for transmission line design, including borehole/CPT information, soil classifications, soil strength and deformation behaviour, groundwater, bedrock, frost depth, corrosivity and backfill suitability.
 Base knowledge of transmission line foundation design and foundation reaction types, including compression, uplift, shear, overturning moment, lateral soil bearing, embedment depth, pile length/diameter considerations and pole/foundation deflection impacts.
 Ability to interpret geotechnical reports at a level sufficient to coordinate with geotechnical and civil/foundation specialists, identify design or constructability risks, and incorporate appropriate assumptions into line design packages.
 Experience in PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE is required.
 Experience using PLS-Tower, PLS-CAISSON, line rating tools, thermal rating methods, reconductoring assessments or line optimization studies would be an asset.
 Experience supporting customer interconnection, Direct Assign, Facility Application, AESO information request, regulatory/hearing or technical justification work would be an asset.
 Experience developing or applying engineering standards, technical specifications, material procurement requirements or supplier technical evaluations would be an asset.
 Experience with foundation-related standards, geotechnical scope development, foundation constructability reviews, or coordination of engineered foundation designs would be an asset.
 Superior organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a wide variety of projects/issues simultaneously.
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work in a team environment with both office and field staff.
 Demonstrated ability to work under tight timelines and in high stress situations.
 Demonstrated mentoring, coaching or technical leadership experience with junior engineers, EITs, designers or cross-functional project teams.
 Must have a valid class 5 driver’s license.
 Ability and willingness to travel to site as required.
 Proven track record of good performance and attendance.
 Notes: 
 Internal candidates must submit their resume internally via https://referrals.workable.com/altalink/jobs/ 
 AltaLink employees should be aware that we may contact your manager during the selection process.  Some positions may require job specific assessments, regular criminal record checks, additional AltaLink training, medical assessments, annual drivers abstract, and drug tests.  Please contact the Hiring Manager or Recruiter for further clarification if required.

About us: 
 At Tall Tree, you’ll join an award-winning clinic focused on exceptional integrated healthcare. We’re a diverse team that is endlessly nerdy— we love learning, teaching, and keeping up to date with the latest research. We’re the most multidisciplinary and comprehensive team in private healthcare in BC; we put each client at the center of this with our goal to match everyone with the right clinician or team of clinicians. We take pride in our passionate clinicians, inspiring and uplifting facilities, high-quality health services, and exceptional customer service. We’re committed to delivering healthcare in the best possible way— and we have a singular culture of respect, warmth, curiosity and enthusiasm that makes being a part of the Tall Tree team something to be truly proud of.  
 Our occupational therapy team benefits from 1:1 mentorship, including report review and optional drop-in office hours, as well as a comprehensive onboarding program designed for both new graduates and clinicians new to private practice. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in weekly OT team meetings, where we unpack complex cases, share new interventions, and learn from guest speakers. Our monthly Lunch & Learns, curated by our in-house Director of Education and Learning, cover topics such as neuroplasticity and functional recovery, motivational interviewing in rehab, and advances in concussion management. Each year, we also gather for a staff retreat—part healthcare TED Talk, part lakeside recharge. Plus, through our sister company, AMP Healthcare, you’ll have access to discounted or free continuing education courses to keep your practice evolving.
 About the role: 
 As an Occupational Therapist at Tall Tree, you’ll play a crucial role in redefining healthcare to prioritize holistic well-being and individualized care. You will deliver high-quality assessment and treatment services to clients facing a range of challenges—from mental health issues and physical injuries to brain injuries and work disabilities. 
 Working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team and providing services in our clinic, community settings, and through telehealth, you’ll craft personalized therapeutic plans that truly reflect the unique needs of each individual. 
 This is a unique opportunity for a dedicated professional who believes in doing healthcare the way it should be done—by focusing on genuine connections, effective solutions, and the overall health of the individuals we serve. 
 Compensation: 
Full-time (5 days per week) community-based therapists have the opportunity to earn $118,000–$130,000+ annually , along with a signing bonus of up to $5,000 .
 The fee split for this role ranges from 52% to 62% , depending on experience and qualifications.
 As an Occupational Therapist at Tall Tree, you will: 
 Evaluate and assess patients using OT frameworks . You’ll develop individualized treatment plans, and provide exceptional care and interventions that are evidence-based, psychologically informed, and patient-centered.  
 Work collaboratively with our interdisciplinary team of Physiotherapists, Kinesiologists, Psychologists, Clinical Counselors, and more when indicated.  
 Collaborate with third party insurance funders, employers, and other relevant stakeholders . You’ll maintain related reports, records, and statistical data in accordance with established standards and procedures. 
 Keep growing. You’ll attend OT community of practice meetings and other educational opportunities available at Tall Tree. You’ll stay current with the latest evidence, findings, trends, and developments to ensure clients receive the best possible care. 
 We’re looking for: 
 Someone qualified to practice Occupational Therapy in British Columbia. You are a member of the College of Occupational Therapists of British Columbia - with a preference for candidates with 2+ experience in private practice.  
 Comparable experience: You have experience working with third party funders such as WSBC, ICBC and Long Term Disability funders (or provincial equivalents). 
 Clinical Excellence: You have a strong foundation in evidence-based practice and a commitment to mastering skills. You hold a profound respect for the complexity of human experience.  
  A commitment to growth: You have a deep passion for learning and continuous growth and development. You bring an openness to exploring new ideas and approaches to service delivery. 
 Great interpersonal and communication skills: You have a proven ability to collaborate effectively within a diverse team. You communicate clearly and effectively, whether you’re speaking, listening, or writing. You use precise language, compelling reassurance, healing narratives, and consistent messages. 
 Enthusiasm for teaching: You love sharing knowledge and can help mentor colleagues. 
 Humility and curiosity: You have an eagerness to learn and collaborate.

 Job Description 
 Contribuez à bâtir l’avenir énergétique!
 Chez GE Vernova, nous relevons chaque jour un défi ambitieux : contribuer à la production d’une énergie plus durable pour les générations futures.
 La lutte contre le changement climatique est une priorité mondiale. En tant qu’entreprise dont la technologie est utilisée pour alimenter environ 25 % de l’électricité dans le monde, nous prenons notre responsabilité au sérieux. GE Vernova est une entreprise qui prend part à une nouvelle ère énergétique – électrifiant le monde tout en travaillant à le décarboniser. Nous accélérons la transition vers une énergie plus fiable, abordable et durable, tout en aidant nos clients à alimenter des économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sûreté, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie.
 L'activité Hydroélectrique de GE Vernova conçoit, développe, fabrique et entretient des technologies avancées qui exploitent la puissance de l'eau pour fournir une énergie fiable et durable. Depuis plus d’un siècle, l’hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans les systèmes électriques nord-américains et mondiaux. Aujourd’hui, il s’agit de la plus grande source d’énergie renouvelable au monde, et la technologie pompage-turbinage représenta la plus grande source de stockage d’énergie. Mais pour atteindre zéro émission nette à l’échelle mondiale d’ici 2050, nous devons doubler la quantité d’hydroélectricité existante. Que ce soit par pompage-turbinage, au fil de l’eau ou en mettant à niveau la base installée existante, l’hydroélectricité continuera d’être la pierre angulaire de l’avenir énergétique de l’Amérique du Nord.

In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

 Work across all Infrastructure teams (Infrastructure Engineering, Network Engineering, Cloud & DevOps, ITSM, and Unified Communications) to identify and address operational requirements for new features and products.

 Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills by addressing complex tactical issues collaboratively and escalating appropriately when necessary. 
 Network Design and Implementation :

 Coach team members on complex network solutions, demonstrating technical breadth across disciplines.

 Conduct assessments that drive business decisions related to network solutions.

 Share knowledge with team members and mentor them on best practices for network and infrastructure design.

 Stay informed about industry trends in both infrastructure and networking to align existing and future solution strategies with business objectives.

 Technology Roadmaps and Standards : 
 Oversee technology roadmaps for core network infrastructure offerings while investigating new technology ideas/opportunities.

 Architecture Development : 
 Help lead the definition and development of architecture, patterns, and guidelines that integrate both infrastructure and network solutions.

 Security Controls Definition : 
 Define security controls for a variety of cloud and on-prem workloads by collaborating closely with Information Security.

 Senior Product Marketing Manager 
 À propos d’AppDirect 
 Devenez un citoyen du monde à l’ère numérique et outillez une nouvelle génération d’entrepreneurs branchés aux quatre coins du globe. AppDirect offre une plateforme d’abonnement permettant de vendre n’importe quel produit en tant que service, et ce, par n’importe quel canal et sur n’importe quel appareil. Nous alimentons des millions d’abonnements pour le compte d’organisations de partout dans le monde. Notre action est toujours guidée par nos valeurs et notre culture – une culture qui vous permet d’être vu, de rester authentique et d’exceller. 
 Votre profil 
 Nous recherchons un ou une responsable du marketing produit prêt(e) à aller au-delà de l'exécution pour prendre en charge une gamme de produits de A à Z. Dans ce rôle, vous serez l’unique voix du marketing produit pour l'unité commerciale concernée. Vous devez être à l'aise à définir vos propres priorités et mener à bien vos tâches de manière autonome et sans supervision quotidienne. Vous savez analyser les informations de veille concurrentielle, les données de réussite/échec et les retours clients pour produire un positionnement clair et des plans de commercialisation concrets sur lesquels les équipes commerciales et produit peuvent agir. Vous comprenez comment fonctionnent les relations avec les analystes et savez comment collaborer avec les clients pour développer des programmes de fidélisation et de marketing d'expansion. Vous êtes aussi à l'aise à rédiger un argumentaire de positionnement percutant que pour analyser les données afin d'évaluer l'efficacité de vos lancements. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec deux autres responsables du marketing produit et un directeur de la gestion des produits pour apporter la perspective de l'unité commerciale aux discussions de planification interfonctionnelles et vous assurer que les responsables des ventes, de la réussite client et du marketing partagent les mêmes priorités. 
 Ce que vous ferez et ce qui vous fera briller 
 Piloter l’ensemble de la stratégie de mise en marché en lien avec les lancements de produits de l'unité commerciale, y compris le positionnement, les critères de réussite et l'exécution interfonctionnelle. 
 Définir les résultats et les indicateurs de rendement du marketing produit, en fonction du pipeline de l'unité commerciale et des objectifs de nouveaux revenus, et suivre les performances par rapport à ces objectifs. 
 Collaborer directement avec le directeur de la gestion des produits pour façonner la feuille de route produit en s'appuyant sur la veille concurrentielle, l'analyse des réussites/échecs et des études de marché. 
 Bâtir et déployer la stratégie marketing client de l'unité commerciale, en privilégiant les programmes de fidélisation et les actions de développement favorisant les ventes croisées sur la plateforme de monétisation unifiée d'AppDirect. 
 Gérer les relations avec les analystes pour l'unité commerciale, notamment les breffages, les demandes d'informations et le positionnement continu auprès de cabinets d'études tels que Gartner. 
 Représenter le point de vue du marketing produit lors des discussions de planification interfonctionnelles avec les équipes commerciales, réussite client et marketing, en traduisant les priorités commerciales en une feuille de route claire. 
 Contribuer à l'analyse des prix et formuler des recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de l'unité commerciale en matière de mise en valeur et de positionnement. 
 Compétences requises 
 +5 ans d’expérience en marketing produit dans un environnement SaaS B2B, avec une expérience éprouvée à piloter des stratégies de mise en marché. 
 Expérience en veille concurrentielle, en étude des succès et des échecs et en analyse du marché; capacité à utiliser les données analysées pour influencer les décisions relatives aux produits et au positionnement. 
 Maîtrise des relations avec les analystes, notamment la préparation de notes d’information et la réponse aux demandes d’études. 
 Expérience en développement de programmes de marketing client ou d’expansion (campagnes de fidélisation, ventes incitatives ou ventes croisées). 
 Capacité à travailler de manière autonome sur plusieurs projets : cette compétence est essentielle, car vous serez le principal responsable du marketing produit pour une unité commerciale et vous définirez votre propre stratégie sans supervision étroite. 
 Communication claire et structurée, autant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit : cette compétence est essentielle, car vous présenterez régulièrement le positionnement et la stratégie aux responsables des ventes et de la gestion des produits, et autres décideurs. 
 L’expérience avec les stratégies de croissance axées sur le produit (PLG) est considérée comme un atout, mais n’est pas obligatoire. 
 Chez AppDirect, nous croyons que l’innovation est à son meilleur dans un environnement favorisant la diversité de l’excellence, de l’expérience et de la pensée. Nous accueillons chaque « AppDirecteur » et « AppDirectrice » pour l’empreinte unique qui est la sienne. Nous favorisons un environnement inclusif et sans discrimination à l’égard de la race, de la religion, de l’âge, de l’orientation sexuelle et de l’identité de genre, afin de favoriser l’authenticité, la fierté et l’excellence. Dans cette optique, nous encourageons fortement les candidatures des personnes autochtones, des personnes handicapées, des personnes issues de la diversité des orientations sexuelles et des genres et/ou des personnes aux identités intersectionnelles. 
 Chez AppDirect, nous prenons la protection de la vie privée très au sérieux. Pour plus d'informations sur notre utilisation et notre gestion des données personnelles des candidats, veuillez lire notre politique de confidentialité des candidats. Pour en savoir plus sur nos pratiques générales en matière de confidentialité, veuillez consulter l'avis de confidentialité d'AppDirect : https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice 
 L’équipe de recrutement d’AppDirect peut faire appel à des outils d'IA pour l’assister dans l'automatisation des tâches administratives, toujours sous supervision humaine. Ces outils ne prennent aucune décision d'embauche ni aucune décision automatisée concernant votre candidature; toutes les décisions sont prises par nos équipes. En soumettant votre candidature, vous acceptez que vos informations puissent être traitées de cette manière. Vous pouvez à tout moment demander l'accès à vos données ou leur suppression en écrivant à privacy@appdirect.com.

TECHNICAL ACCOUNTING MANAGER

Level: P4
Location: Remote | Canada
Department: Finance
Reports To: Urvi Kamleshkumar Shah | Assistant Controller https://www.linkedin.com/in/urvi-shah-canada/
Type: Permanent | Full-Time
Vacancy Status: This is an active role and we are currently hiring for this position.

ABOUT SOLINK

Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Technical Accounting Manager to be our go-to person on technical accounting research, keeping our accounting policies current, and assisting with complex transaction accounting for the company. This role is distinct from the core close/consolidation function — it's focused on getting the judgment calls right: revenue recognition for complex or bundled hardware/software arrangements, new accounting pronouncements, and one-off or non-routine transactions. You'll report to the Assistant Controller and act as the internal technical resource for the rest of the accounting and finance operations team, as well as a key liaison to external auditors on complex matters.

Given our hardware-enabled SaaS model and multi-entity structure reporting under IFRS, this role has real scope for meaningful technical work — multi-element revenue arrangements, lease accounting, share-based payments, and financial instruments, among others.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Research and document technical accounting positions on complex or non-routine transactions (e.g., multi-element hardware/SaaS bundled arrangements, contract modifications, new product launches).

 - Draft accounting memos supporting judgment areas under IFRS (e.g., IFRS 15 revenue recognition, IFRS 16 leases, IFRS 2 share-based payments, IAS 36 impairment).

 - Monitor new and amended IFRS pronouncements, assess impact on the business, and lead implementation efforts.

 - Partner with Legal, Sales, and Product teams to review new contract structures and advise on accounting implications before deals close.

 - Work with the Assistant Controller to review technical accounting policies and ensure they are documented, current, and consistently applied across all legal entities.

 - Act as the primary point of contact for auditors on technical accounting matters and complex areas of judgment.

 - Support M&A due diligence and purchase accounting, if applicable.

 - Partner with the Assistant Controller on the practical application of technical positions during the close process.

 - Provide training and guidance to the broader accounting team on technical topics.

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are established contributors who work independently within their area of expertise while receiving general direction from their manager.

 - Serves as the go-to resource for IFRS interpretation on complex, non-routine transactions for the accounting team and the entire organization

 - Drafts technical accounting memos and position papers with minimal oversight

 - Evaluates new revenue arrangements, leases, or financial instruments for accounting treatment

 - Own Solink’s accounting policy manual

What success looks like:

 - Solink accounting policy manual is completed and up to date

 - Clean and efficient annual audit process

 - Solink prepared well in advance of any accounting changes impacting financial reporting

WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field; CPA or CA required (or in progress).

 - 3-5 years of accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or large regional firm) experience strongly preferred.

 - Deep working knowledge of IFRS, with particular strength in revenue recognition (IFRS 15) and other judgment-heavy areas.

 - Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research and first-draft memo preparation, with rigorous review and professional judgment applied before finalizing any position.

 - Experience with multi-element or bundled revenue arrangements — hardware/software combined offerings a strong plus.

 - Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear, well-supported accounting memos.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-accounting stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Product).

Preferred Experience

 - Exposure to IFRS reporting.

 - Experience working directly with external auditors on complex accounting matters.

 - Experience in a hardware-enabled SaaS or similarly complex revenue environment.

 - Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency reporting structures.

 - Experience leading new accounting standard implementation projects.

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

   

WHY SOLINK?

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

 1. Introductory Call With Our Talent Team

 2. Interview With the Hiring Manager

 3. Role-Relevant Task or Case Study (if applicable)

 4. Final Interviews With Cross-Functional Team Members

You will partner with operators, reliability engineers, and IT leaders to integrate live equipment data into MaintainX, connect sensors and operational technology (OT) systems, and ensure customers realize measurable return on investment from these solutions. This role sits at the intersection of customer success, industrial IoT, and data analytics. You will collaborate closely with our Account Managers, Product Managers, and Engineering teams to shape how customers use and benefit from our Asset Intelligence capabilities.

What you’ll do:

 - Serve as a trusted advisor: Build deep relationships with customers and understand their maintenance and reliability objectives. Become a go‑to resource on predictive maintenance, condition‑based monitoring, and asset performance.

 - Drive value realization: Help customers define success metrics and quantify ROI from predictive maintenance. Review usage and key performance indicators, perform Quarterly Business Reviews, and recommend strategies to improve asset health, reduce downtime and optimize maintenance costs.

 - Educate and enable: Conduct product demonstrations, training sessions, and webinars to ensure customers understand how to use Asset Intelligence features effectively. Provide best‑practice guidance on topics like condition‑based maintenance, usage‑based preventive maintenance, anomaly detection, and downtime tracking.

In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it - banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card+4 digit PIN over 60 years later.

It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. Legal Engineers across all three subgroups understand how lawyers think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live in-practice pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what the legal profession needs. It's a team built to power Harvey as the platform lawyers can trust with their most important work.

 

You may be asked to travel around 2-3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1-3 days at a time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Legal Engineer (Pre-Sales)

Legal Engineers are lawyers who left practice to help build the future of legal work. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams throughout the pre-sales process. They lead collaborative pilot programs, guide prospects through what’s possible with AI, and work alongside lawyers to understand their workflows, build tailored solutions, and demonstrate meaningful value in real legal use cases. Along the way, they bring prospect feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey.

 

Legal Engineer, Product Specialist (Post-Sales)

LEPS take over once a prospect becomes a customer. LEPS build trusted relationships with many of the world's leading legal teams by learning their workflows and showing them how to weave Harvey into daily practice.  The LEPS role spans the entire customer journey, from leading onboarding and enablement, to sitting down with a full practice group to build agents on real matters. Along the way, the LEPS translates legal practice needs into actionable feedback for product and engineering, contributes to customer-facing content across practice areas, and upholds Harvey's credibility as the leading AI platform for lawyers.

 

Legal Engineer, Custom Solutions (Pre-Sale and Post-Sale)

LECS are a specialist group that work on complex no-code custom Harvey in-app solutions. LECS meet with group heads, general counsel, and other senior stakeholders to learn how key processes run today. Drawing on their legal expertise, they use natural language prompting to design bespoke resources, including agents, playbooks, and other tools, that improve the quality, speed, and experience of that process. The build is collaborative. The LECS scope it with the customer, prototype against sample documents, and refine it alongside their team. Most LECS work happens post-sale, but the team also supports strategic accounts pre-sale on an advisory basis. LECS concentrates narrowly on designing tools that automate a specific process, and on building relationships with the senior leaders who own it.

 

*In your initial interview with our recruiting team, you'll learn more about all three roles, and we'll identify which may be the best fit based on your background and our current hiring needs.

What You Have

You move confidently through uncertainty, you operate at speed, and ship solutions that work—iterating quickly with lawyers, sales teams, and product partners to help Harvey and its customers win. You bring deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform legal work, a bias toward action, and the creativity to solve problems nobody's cracked yet.

 - Deep understanding of corporate legal workflows (e.g., commercial contracting, governance, compliance, or transactions) and curiosity about how AI can reshape them.

 - Executive presence and strong relationship-building skills, with experience engaging business stakeholders, senior leadership, and cross-functional partners.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with product, sales, or business teams in an in-house setting; customer-facing or business development experience is a plus.

AmeXio est un partenaire mondial de la transformation numérique pour les entreprises et les institutions gouvernementales. Nous aidons les entreprises dans leur croissance numérique dans les domaines de la gestion de l'expérience client, du contenu d'entreprise, de la communication client et du contenu structuré.
 Notre client, un leader de l’industrie aérospatiale, est à la recherche d’un(e) Product Owner / Analyste d’affaires pour contribuer à la réussite de ses projets et assurer l’alignement entre les besoins d’affaires, les équipes techniques et les utilisateurs finaux.
 Le rôle de Product Owner / Analyste d’affaires est essentiel pour traduire les besoins des parties prenantes en exigences claires et réalisables. À la croisée des affaires et des technologies, la personne titulaire du poste contribue à définir la vision du produit, à prioriser les besoins et à assurer la livraison de solutions qui répondent aux objectifs de l’organisation.
 Elle agit comme intermédiaire entre les parties prenantes, les équipes de développement et les utilisateurs finaux, tout en favorisant la collaboration et l’amélioration continue dans un environnement de travail agile
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien? 
 Vision & Stratégie du Produit : 
 Agir en tant que principal point de contact entre les parties prenantes (entreprise, clients et équipes de développement).
 Recueillir les avis, les retours et les exigences des propriétaires d'entreprise, des clients et des autres parties prenantes pour s'assurer que le produit répond à leurs besoins.
 Organiser des sessions régulières de retour d'information et de révisions avec les parties prenantes pour garantir l'alignement.
 Développer et maintenir une feuille de route décrivant les fonctionnalités du produit, les améliorations et les livrables.

 Créer des documents de requis d’affaires et fonctionnels détaillés.
 Créer, maintenir et prioriser le backlog produit, en veillant à ce qu'il soit clair et réalisable pour l'équipe de développement.
 Rédiger des histoires utilisateurs détaillées, définir les critères d'acceptation et garantir la clarté des exigences.
 Prioriser en continu les tâches en fonction de la valeur commerciale, de la demande du marché et de la faisabilité technique.
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement, y compris les ingénieurs logiciels, les concepteurs et les testeurs, pour garantir une compréhension partagée des exigences et des priorités.
 Participer aux cérémonies agiles telles que la planification des sprints, l'affinage du backlog et les revues de sprint.

 Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour définir les critères d'acceptation. Veiller à ce que les fonctionnalités livrées respectent les normes de qualité et les attentes des utilisateurs.
 Effectuer des tests d'acceptation utilisateur (UAT) pour valider que les solutions livrées répondent aux exigences commerciales et aux besoins des utilisateurs.

About the Role

As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser.

 - Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target

 - Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce

 - Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order

 - Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one

 - Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations

 - Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next

 - Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards

 - Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site

An ideal candidate has

 - 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus

 - A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account

 - Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced

 - Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights

 - Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams

 - Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business
